lines.en: : *Sigh*
I’m at school early again at Makoto's behest since there is apparently a lot I need to catch up on in terms of grading.
How? I have no idea. In fact, I'm beginning to suspect that she might be assigning work behind my back.
But at least I'm able to handle it all online through some virtual gradebook thing she told me about.
Or at least I'm supposed to be able to handle it online. It's kind of hard to do that without knowing my login credentials.
So, here I am wandering the halls of the school and waiting for someone to reset my password so I can actually do my job.
I swear, it's like this school doesn't even want me to teach sometimes...
I make my way into the classroom to kill some time as it apparently takes a full hour to make my new login stuff.
I initially planned on using that time to try and figure out a way to ask Makoto to just handle this for me...
But a certain someone who decided to show up early today causes me to throw those plans out of the window as soon as I set foot inside the room.
: Sensei? What are you doing here so early?
: Losing faith in our educational system when I should probably be losing faith in myself instead.
: Woah. That's kinda deep for this early in the morning.
: The real answer is that I'm supposed to be doing grading stuff. Unfortunately, circumstances have arisen in which I am unable to do that.
: Does this mean we all get A's for doing literally nothing?
: No. It means that you all have blank grades for the foreseeable future. A's are what you would have if I remembered my password.
: What are you doing, though? You don't normally come here this early, do you?
: Not all the time. Just when I have to catch up on stuff.
: Can't you catch up on stuff at the dorms? Why do you have to come all the way over here?
: Probs cause Yumi was in a bad mood this morning and I didn't want to smack a bitch.
: Yumi in a bad mood? How can this be?
: Hahah...I know, right? When has that ever happened before?
: You know...
: I'm sure it might be hard for you to believe, but she isn’t always like that.
: Yumi can actually be pretty chill when she's not surrounded by, like...school and people and all that stuff.
: She's just got a really short fuse and gets triggered way too easily. And whenever she does, it takes like, forever for her to come back down.
: Well, what triggered her this time?
: Ummm...
: Waking up?
: Chika, that's not a short fuse. That is the complete absence of a fuse.
: I know, I know. And usually I'm able to tell what it is. But she was like, super pissed the whole weekend and I still don't really get why.
: Like how am I supposed to cheer her up if she won't even tell me what's wrong?
: No clue. Which is why I've pretty much just given up on trying to understand her in the first place.
: Well, I can’t really blame you for doing something like that...
: But I do think that you might be able to break through to her if you try hard enough.
: I think you might be misunderstanding my relationship with her.
: Well, isn't it possible that you might be misunderstanding her a little bit too?
: I mean...I guess?
: The thing with Yumi is...
: Well, things for her haven't exactly been easy. Let's just go with that.
: Honestly, even saying that much is more than she'd want me to tell you.
: But, basically...she’s not just super mad all the time just because she thinks it makes her look cool or whatever.
: So what, though? It’s not like she’s the only person in the world going through tough times.
: Her not having it easy shouldn't allow her to talk down on everyone else.
: I know it probably sounds like an excuse...and I'm not saying that I think that she should get away with all of the stuff she does.
: I just don’t want you thinking she’s some sort of lost cause.
: Like...if anyone was gonna break through to her, I think it would kinda have to be you.
: Aren’t you her best friend? Why can’t you ‘break through to her?’
: Listen...I love the girl. But if I was gonna be the saving grace she needed, I would have already broken through by now.
: I’m here to be her friend and support her, but what she needs is something a lot bigger than that.
: And you seem pretty big to me, Sensei.
I want that to be a euphemism but, based on the context of this conversation, I'm pretty confident it's not.
: Like...what are you? 6’2 or something?
I have now confirmed that it's not.
: Something like that. I'm not really the type to keep track of numbers.
: Better be careful who you say stuff like that to, you know. The wrong person might...misinterpret that.
: Maybe I want them to?
: Ooooh...are you always this spicy in the morning? Or did I just happen to catch you on a good day?
: I like to think of it as less spice and more of a...complete lack of a moral compass.
: Don't put yourself down like that. I know there's a great guy somewhere in that approximately 6'2ish body of yours.
: And I know you just told me you don't keep track of numbers, but do you think you could help out with this algebra stuff?
: I know you don't want to teach during the school day anymore, but...school technically hasn't started yet. So it should be okay, right?
: What happens if I say it's not?
: I don't know. I'll probs just get held back again or something.
: Again? You’ve been held back before?
: Wait, you didn't know that? I figured that would have been something they told you in the beginning of the year.
: Oh. Well, uhh...I probably just forgot it then.
Or...never learned it in the first place.
: What happened, exactly? If you're here early just to study and your attitude isn't that bad-
: Just...you know. The whole Chinami situation makes keeping up with school pretty tough sometimes.
: It's not exactly easy taking care of a kid at my age and whatnot.
: I just...
: I sorta had some stuff I needed to take care of. That's all.
: It’s not a big deal, really.
: And it’s gotten a lot easier to manage in the last year, so...
: But hey, if worse comes to worst and I do get held back again...maybe you'll be my teacher a second time?
: Well, let’s hope it doesn’t come to that.
: Also, if you ever need help with anything outside of[school]...I'm not entirely opposed, you know.
: Oh, no no no no no! I wasn't trying to ask for help or anything! You really don’t have to worry about me! I'm fine!
: I’ve got everything totally under control. Seriously.
: I’m sure you do. I’m just saying it’s okay to ask for help if you need it.
: Well...thanks, Sensei...
: I’ll try to remember that...
: Works for me. Just don't burn yourself out.
: Hey, umm...
: Do you mind if I ask you a, like...super weird question?
: I...guess?
: Okay, so like...
: What made you decide to get all...cool this far into the school year?
: Like...you were totally different in the beginning of the year. Now, you're turning into somebody that pretty much all of us admire.
: That's probably just one of the results of letting all of you slack off whenever you want.
: No...No, I think it's more than that.
: It's more like...you're a completely different-
The bell chimes and saves me from having to answer a very difficult question.
: Wow...has it really been an hour already?
: And I still don't have my new password. I think it might be time for me to find a new teaching job.
: Ha. Good luck with that. I can't imagine any other schools in Kumon-mi accepting your methods as easily as this one.
: For what it's worth, the school hasn't accepted anything. It's just you girls who know about that.
: Well, doesn't that make me feel special?...
After a few minutes, the rest of the girls begin to filter in and yet another day of school begins.
Chika never gets my help with algebra, but I'm sure she'll be fine on her own.
She's already managed much harder things, after all...
But, hey...if she doesn't-
I don't think I'd mind having her in my class for one more year.
Chika's affection has increased to [chika_love]!
